title: CSCI 536 — Information Retrieval
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and explain the core components of a search engine pipeline, including indexing, retrieval, and ranking.
Compare traditional statistical retrieval models (TF-IDF, BM25) with modern neural retrieval techniques and their respective strengths.
Apply standard evaluation metrics to assess search engine performance and identify common failure modes like data leakage or distribution shift.
